objective: validation+actual future output SSE at fixed training R/X
scope: Method-wise, true-candidate-family rank calibration under exchangeability of independent histories in the declared synthetic distribution. Rank retention requires true-candidate coverage; omitted truths are counted separately and included in the empirical overall false-reject rate. No field guarantee or simultaneous multi-strategy error control.

summary.cost_scope: Actual solver totals are per history; per-method logical fit costs can share cached curves.
